shellCommands.command: cat package-lock.json | grep -A2 '"next":' | head -5; echo '---'; ls node_modules/next/dist/server 2>/dev/null | head -20 || echo 'no node_modules'
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40

grep -rn "generateStaticParams" node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/ 2>/dev/null | head; echo '---searchParams type---'; grep -rn "searchParams" node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/work-unit-async-storage.external.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo '---'; find node_modules/next/dist -name "*.d.ts" | xargs grep -ln "generateStaticParams" 2>/dev/null | head
sed -n '170,200p' node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/blocking-route-messages.js

grep -rn '"use cache"' node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo '---use cache docs/messages---'; grep -rln "use cache" node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/ 2>/dev/null | head; echo '---check for cacheComponents docs---'; grep -rn "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/build/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -3

grep -rn "searchParams" node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/work-unit-async-storage.external.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo '---page props type---'; find node_modules/next/dist -name "*.d.ts" -exec grep -ln "searchParams" {} \; 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -ln "Promise" 2>/dev/null | head; echo '---search for SearchParams type def---'; grep -rn "type SearchParams\|SearchParams =" node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head
cat node_modules/next/dist/server/request/search-params.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; grep -rn "searchParams" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/client-page.d.ts 2>/dev/null
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25
find .next/server/app -name '*.html' 2>/dev/null | head; echo '---catalog html---'; find .next/server/app -path '*catalog*' 2>/dev/null | head -20

echo '=== catalog.html (prerendered shell) ==='; cat .next/server/app/catalog.html; echo; echo '=== __PAGE__.segment.rsc (dynamic hole content?) ==='; ls -la .next/server/app/catalog.segments/catalog/
cat .next/server/app/catalog.segments/catalog/__PAGE__.segment.rsc | strings | head -40
cat .next/server/app/catalog.segments/catalog/__PAGE__.segment.rsc | tr -c '[:print:]\n' ' ' | tr -s ' ' | head -c 2000
npm run start -- --port 3210

echo '=== Home page links ==='; curl -s http://localhost:3210/ | grep -o 'href="/catalog[^"]*"' | head; echo; echo '=== Catalog prefetch RSC payload (featured) ==='; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22catalog%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%5D' 'http://localhost:3210/catalog?category=featured' | tr -c '[:print:]\n' ' ' | tr -s ' ' | head -c 1500

echo '=== First request to catalog?category=featured (cold cache) ==='; curl -s -w '
[time_total=%{time_total}s]
' 'http://localhost:3210/catalog?category=featured' -o /tmp/cat1.html; echo; echo 'Content snippet:'; grep -o 'Loading category\|Featured products\|Desk Lamp\|Wool Blanket' /tmp/cat1.html | sort | uniq -c; echo; echo '=== Second request (warm cache) ==='; curl -s -w '
[time_total=%{time_total}s]
' 'http://localhost:3210/catalog?category=featured' -o /tmp/cat2.html; grep -o 'Loading category\|Featured products\|Desk Lamp\|Wool Blanket' /tmp/cat2.html | sort | uniq -c

echo '=== Try prefetch with RSC header only ==='; curl -s -D /tmp/h.txt -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3210/catalog?category=featured' -o /tmp/prefetch.txt; echo '--- headers ---'; cat /tmp/h.txt | head -20; echo '--- body (printable) ---'; cat /tmp/prefetch.txt | tr -c '[:print:]\n' ' ' | tr -s ' ' | head -c 1200; echo; echo '--- contains products? ---'; grep -c 'Desk Lamp' /tmp/prefetch.txt

curl -s -D /tmp/h.txt -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3210/catalog?category=featured' -o /tmp/prefetch.txt || true; echo '--- headers ---'; cat /tmp/h.txt 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo '--- body size ---'; wc -c /tmp/prefetch.txt 2>/dev/null; echo '--- body (printable, head) ---'; head -c 1200 /tmp/prefetch.txt 2>/dev/null | tr -c '[:print:]\n' ' ' | tr -s ' '; echo; echo '--- contains products? ---'; grep -c 'Desk Lamp' /tmp/prefetch.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0

curl -sL -D /tmp/h.txt -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3210/catalog?category=featured' -o /tmp/prefetch.txt || true; echo '--- headers ---'; cat /tmp/h.txt 2>/dev/null | tail -20; echo '--- body size ---'; wc -c /tmp/prefetch.txt 2>/dev/null; echo '--- contains products? ---'; grep -c 'Desk Lamp' /tmp/prefetch.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0; echo '--- contains Loading? ---'; grep -c 'Loading category' /tmp/prefetch.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0; echo '--- body printable head ---'; head -c 1500 /tmp/prefetch.txt 2>/dev/null | tr -c '[:print:]\n' ' ' | tr -s ' '
grep -rn "rewrites" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo '---'; grep -rn "Rewrite" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25

echo '=== Prerendered catalog.html content ==='; grep -o 'Loading category\|Featured products\|Products on sale\|Desk Lamp\|Wool Blanket\|Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug' .next/server/app/catalog.html | sort | uniq -c; echo; echo '=== Prerendered index.html links ==='; grep -o 'href="/catalog[^"]*"' .next/server/app/index.html
npm run start -- --port 3211

echo '=== Catalog request timing + content ==='; curl -s -w '
[time_total=%{time_total}s]
' 'http://localhost:3211/catalog?category=sale' -o /tmp/cat.html; echo 'Loading state present?'; grep -c 'Loading category' /tmp/cat.html || echo 0; echo 'Products present?'; grep -o 'Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug\|Products on sale\|Desk Lamp\|Featured products' /tmp/cat.html | sort | uniq -c; echo; echo '=== Prefetch payload (follow redirects) ==='; curl -sL -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3211/catalog?category=sale' -o /tmp/pf.txt -w '[time=%{time_total}s]
'; echo 'Prefetch contains products?'; grep -c 'Canvas Tote' /tmp/pf.txt || echo 0; echo 'Prefetch contains loading?'; grep -c 'Loading category' /tmp/pf.txt || echo 0

echo '=== Home page ==='; curl -s 'http://localhost:3211/' -o /tmp/home.html; grep -o 'Shop by category\|href="/catalog[^"]*"\|Featured products\|Products on sale' /tmp/home.html | sort | uniq -c; echo; echo '=== Both categories served correctly ==='; for c in featured sale; do echo "--- $c ---"; curl -s "http://localhost:3211/catalog?category=$c" | grep -o "$c" | head -1; done
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "tsc exit: $?"

(timeout 25 npm run dev -- --port 3212 > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 12; echo '=== dev: catalog request ==='; curl -s -w '\n[time=%{time_total}s]\n' 'http://localhost:3212/catalog?category=sale' -o /tmp/devcat.html; echo 'Loading present?'; grep -c 'Loading category' /tmp/devcat.html || echo 0; echo 'Products present?'; grep -o 'Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug\|Products on sale' /tmp/devcat.html | sort | uniq -c; echo; echo '=== dev log tail ==='; tail -5 /tmp/dev.log

sleep 1; echo '=== dev: warm catalog request ==='; curl -s -w '\n[time=%{time_total}s]\n' 'http://localhost:3212/catalog?category=sale' -o /tmp/devcat2.html; echo 'Loading present?'; grep -c 'Loading category' /tmp/devcat2.html || echo 0; echo 'Products present?'; grep -o 'Canvas Tote' /tmp/devcat2.html | head -1; pkill -f 'next dev' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'next-server' 2>/dev/null; true
pkill -f 'next dev' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'next-server' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'next start' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo 'cleaned up'
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -12
